purpose: Lets a reviewer determine the target type (code, requirement, design, plan, uxui) of each review target and select which documents to read for that type.
summary: Defines five target types: code, requirement, design, plan, uxui; ADR is treated as design
Procedure for determining type by querying the doc structure configuration via a resolver script
Mapping table from returned doc_type to next action and target type
Rules for detecting UI-related documents and for classifying null doc_type as source code or not
Handling of undeterminable targets: use only the common documents, no findings or errors
List of common documents applied to all targets: generic criteria, review priorities, proportionality, error classification
Per-type tables of review criteria, built-in norms, project-specific rules, and cross-check targets
Does not duplicate norm content; only holds the type-to-document correspondence
tasks: Reviewing code, requirements, designs, plans, or UI/UX documents
Classifying a review target by type
Selecting reference documents for a review
Authoring or modifying the reviewer agent definition
Adding a new review target type or criteria document
title: レビュー対象の種別と読む文書
